verdict.rationale: Vestd's own share-issuance flow lets an admin authorise a share pool and distribute equity to one or more recipients in a single action, which is a form of batch issuance. Its migration offering ('digitise or move your existing scheme') suggests existing records can be brought in, but the evidence never describes a bulk upload or CSV import mechanism for historical transactions. Missing for 10: documented bulk/CSV upload of grants or historical transactions, batch option-grant workflow details, migration import mechanics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can upload or issue securities in bulk — a batch of grants or historical transactions — instead of entering them one at a time

citations.quote: Authorise a share pool and choose a share class, then instantly distribute the equity to one or more recipients.
Migrate to Vestd - Digitise or move your existing scheme
